answer: Shards are assigned from the zephyr graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. The terrace assignment is published and dawn records each panel. A farm of 2271 identities would post 4969 proofs and burn roughly 5 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
